reviewNotes: Held back: the page gives no year for the tune. Imported from CCEH tune 001177 (the melody read from 001177a.mid, checked against the page's do-re-mi incipit, note for note); check the notes and the bar lines against a hymn book you trust, then set "reviewed": true. Louis Bourgeois's dates (1510–1561) are from our page for the tune OLD 100TH (content/hymns/tunes/old-100th-awake-my-soul-and-with-the-sun.json); CCEH's page gives none. The bar lines are those of CCEH's Noteworthy score (001177a.nwc). The tune ends on Bb, neither doh nor lah: it may be modal; the doh is the key signature's.
